The '''Omni Geode''' is a [[Minerals#Geodes|Mineral deposit]] found primarily by breaking rocks in [[the Mines]]. It can be broken open at the [[Blacksmith]] for {{Price|25}} or placed in a [[Geode Crusher]] to obtain the items inside. Omni Geodes can contain [[minerals]], [[artifacts]], ores, or basic [[:Category:Resources|resources]]. They can also be traded to the [[Desert Trader]] for a variety of items.

'''Note:''' Neither daily [[luck]] nor luck [[buffs]] affect the contents of an Omni Geode.

==Locations==
*Rocks in [[the Mines]] (Floors 21+) or [[Skull Cavern]].
*[[Mining#Omni Geode Node|Omni Geode Nodes]] in the [[Volcano Dungeon]].
*[[The Mines#Crates and Barrels|Crates and barrels]] in the Mines (Floors 80+), Skull Cavern, or Volcano Dungeon.
*[[The Mines#Dirt Patches|Dirt patches]] in the Mines or Skull Cavern.
*[[Carbon Ghost]] drop (99% chance).
*[[Haunted Skull]] drop (1.3% chance, only if all [[Bundles#Vault|Vault Bundles]] are not complete).
*[[Wilderness Golem]] and [[Iridium Golem]] drop (5% chance, after reaching [[Combat]] Level 5).
*[[Pans|Panning]] in any area.
*[[Artifact Spot]]s on [[Ginger Island]].
*1, 3, or 10 Omni Geodes can be produced by an [[Octopus]] [[Fish Pond]] when the population reaches 9.
*Up to 3 can be purchased from the [[Oasis]] on [[Days of the Week#Wednesday|Wednesdays]] for {{Price|500}} each.
*One can be purchased from [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Tuesday|Tuesdays]] for {{Price|300}}.
*5 Omni Geodes are the reward for completing the {{Bundle|Geologists||y}}.
*3 Omni Geodes are one of the prizes from the [[Trout Derby]].
*8 Omni Geodes are the 18th prize from the [[Mayor's Manor#Prize Machine|Prize Machine]].
*5 or 10 Omni Geodes can be obtained from Skull Cavern [[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|treasure rooms]].
*2-4 Omni Geodes may occasionally be found in [[Supply Crate]]s on the [[Farm Maps#Beach|Beach Farm]] if the player upgraded the [[Farmhouse]] at least once.
*Crane Game in the [[Movie Theater]] lobby, during any season.
*The [[Garbage Can]] outside of the [[Museum]].
* A fallen [[Random Events#Meteorite|meteorite]] on [[the Farm]] will drop 2 Omni Geodes when mined.

==Omni Geode Contents==
It is impossible for the player to receive a Prismatic Shard before cracking at least 15 Omni Geodes. Therefore, the probability of receiving a Prismatic Shard is 0 and receiving any minerals or artifacts is 1/88 if the player has not yet cracked 15 Omni Geodes. The probabilities shown below reflect the probability after cracking at least 15 Omni Geodes.

===Geode Minerals===
An Omni Geode can contain any of the 41 [[Minerals#Geode Minerals|Geode Minerals]] in the game. Each has a 31/2750 chance to appear.

===Resources===
Coal, copper ore, iron ore, and gold ore will be obtained in the following amounts: 30% for 1, 30% for 3, 30% for 5, 9% for 10, and 1% for 20. Stone has a 50% chance to use those values and a 50% chance to give only 1. Iridium Ore has a 30% chance for 1, 30% for 2, 30% for 3, 9% for 6, and 1% for 11. Only 1 clay can be obtained from a single geode.

==Bundles==
Omni Geode is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
Omni Geode can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[File:Shirt264.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Omni Shirt]]. It can be used as a gray [[Dyeing|dye]] when used in the spool of the [[Sewing Machine]] with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

==Quests==
*2-3 Omni Geodes may be requested by [[Octopus]], [[Rainbow Trout]], [[Spook Fish]], [[Sturgeon]], or [[Super Cucumber]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 5 to 7.
*[[Marlon]] may request the player to obtain 12 Omni Geodes in the [[Desert Festival#Skull Cavern|"Treasure Hunt" quest]] during the [[Desert Festival]].

==Trading==
*5 Omni Geodes can be traded to the [[Desert Trader]] for 1 [[Artifact Trove]].
*3 Omni Geodes can be traded to the [[Desert Trader]] for 1 [[Warp Totem: Desert]].
*50 Omni Geodes can be traded to the [[Desert Trader]] for 1 [[Green Turban]].
*1 Omni Geode can be traded to the [[Desert Trader]] for 3 [[Hay]] on Mondays.
*333 Omni Geodes can be traded to the [[Desert Trader]] for 1 [[Magic Turban]] on even-numbered days.
*333 Omni Geodes can be traded to the [[Desert Trader]] for 1 [[Magic Cowboy Hat]] on odd-numbered days.

==External Links==
Users with access to their [[Saves|saved game files]] may find the "Stardew Predictor" utility helpful for predicting which items will be produced from breaking open geodes.  The utility is located at:  https://mouseypounds.github.io/stardew-predictor/
